hero.description2: Chance to Partner & Get Incubated with Onuschain.

about.title: INTRODUCTION
about.objective: BlockAiThon is a creative competition focused on Blockchain, AI, and Digital Assets. Its goal is to identify and nurture potential projects with the support of Onus, while also recruiting talented individuals. This is an innovation playground for developers, students, startups, and businesses to bring breakthrough technology ideas to life.
about.opportunities: BlockAiThon offers a golden opportunity for teams to turn breakthrough technology ideas into reality, receive incubation from Onus, and access resources and mentorship to bring their products to the real market, while also building the “Make in Vietnam” brand.

competition-structure.title: COMPETITION STRUCTURE
competition-structure.description: The journey from the Application Round to the Finals, with a clear set of scoring criteria to help teams define their strategy.
competition-structure.subtitle: Eligible Participants
competition-structure.sub-description: Teams of two (02) to five (05) members, meeting at least one of the following conditions:

card-description.object1: From any field of study, with basic knowledge of blockchain or AI, and a spirit of learning and creativity.
card-description.object2: Teams with a startup idea looking to implement solutions in blockchain, AI, digital assets, or digital technology.
card-description.object3: Young professionals passionate about researching AI, blockchain, digital assets, or digital technology.
card-description.object4: Companies currently operating in blockchain, AI, digital technology, digital assets, etc.

description.point2: Selection: Top 50 projects from each category will be chosen, followed by pitching to select the Top 30 for the Semifinals.
Selection: After training, teams pitch to select the Top 15 from each category to advance to the Finals.

description.point1: Format: Online pitching (bracket round) + offline competition in Da Nang (Finals).
description.point2: Selection: After intensive training, the Top 10 teams from each category will pitch directly to determine the winners.
description.point3: The best team from each category will also participate in experiential activities.
description.point4: The Organizing Committee announces the winners, awards prizes, closes the event, and takes commemorative photos.

description.point1: Originality and creativity of the idea
description.point5: Additional criteria: project completeness, brand recognition, presentation skills, explanation, and rebuttal

competition-tracks.title: COMPETITION CATEGORIES
competition-tracks.description: From Blockchain to AI, and the potential synergy of both – this is where bold ideas are nurtured, turning technology into a driving force for the digital world.

track1.title: BLOCKCHAIN HACKATHON
track1.description: Focus on blockchain technology, tokenomics, smart contracts, DeFi, NFT, SocialFi, GameFi, etc.

track2.title: AI HACKATHON
track2.description: For ideas leveraging artificial intelligence to solve real-world problems in finance, digital economy, or digital assets. Focus on AI/ML applications, NLP, GenAI, and AI ethics.

track3.title: BLOCKCHAIN & AI HACKATHON
track3.description: A special category for pioneering teams combining Blockchain and AI to create solutions for data verification, automated transactions, security, and AI transparency.

competition-rules.title: COMPETITION REGULATIONS
competition-rules.description: These rules apply to all participating teams. Please read carefully and comply.

benefit.title: Benefits
benefit.point1: Access to training, mentorship, and technical support from experts.
benefit.point2: Support for in-depth training and technical consulting (especially for the top 30).
benefit.point3: Expanded career opportunities and investment solicitation.
benefit.point4: Teams have the right to notify the Organizing Committee of any arising issues.
benefit.point5: Teams have the right to appeal the competition results or any violations by other teams via official email.

responsibility.title: Responsibilities
responsibility.point1: At least 50% of team members must participate in activities and events organized by the Organizing Committee.
responsibility.point2: Comply with the rules and deadlines set by the Organizing Committee.
responsibility.point3: Take responsibility for intellectual property rights and keep competition documents confidential.
responsibility.point4: Ensure all provided information is truthful and take responsibility if found to be false.
responsibility.point5: No cheating, ethical or legal violations, or insults to the competition and other teams.
responsibility.point6: Teams may not change their member structure once the competition has started.
responsibility.point7: All meetings (Mentoring, Investors...) related to the project must be scheduled and reported to the Organizing Committee at least 24 hours in advance.

warning.title: Warning
warning.point2: Immediate correction required via official notice.

reprimand.title: Reprimand
reprimand.point1: Repeated or moderately serious offense affecting the competition’s reputation.

point-deduction.title: Point Deduction
point-deduction.point1: Violation of procedures (late submission, data falsification, incorrect application format, etc.).
point-deduction.point2: Deduction decided by the Organizing Committee.

disqualification.title: Disqualification
disqualification.point1: Serious violations: plagiarism, cheating, copyright infringement, ethical or legal violations.
disqualification.point2: The Organizing Committee reserves the right to publicly announce disqualification.

champion.title: Champion
champion.subtitle: The highest prize package of the competition
champion.description: in cash and in-kind rewards for the winning team
